faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DIAT recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the DIAT recruitment for Senior Research Fellow/Junior Research Fellow/Project Assistant posts is 30-09-2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DIAT recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available for the posts of Senior Research Fellow (3), Junior Research Fellow (3), and Project Assistant (1) in the DIAT recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post, candidates need a B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in Physics/Electronics/Applied Physics/Optics/Photonics with NET/GATE or M.E./M.Tech with First Division at both Graduate and Post Graduate levels.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant (PA) position is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for SC/ST, Women & PwBD, and OBC (NCL) categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their bio-data and other required documents to the specified email addresses.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is ₹42,000/- + 30% HRA if possessing NET/GATE qualification, and ₹33,000/- + 30% HRA if not possessing NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q7. Does DIAT offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, DIAT offers age relaxation for reserved categories. SC/ST candidates get 05 years relaxation, Women & PwBD candidates get 05 years relaxation, and OBC (NCL) candidates get 03 years relaxation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an interview, which can be conducted either in-person or via video conference.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be sent via email?
faq.answer: Candidates need to send a brief bio-data, duly signed application form, Proof of Date of Birth, and mark sheets and degree certificates for relevant qualifications in PDF form as a single file.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of DIAT?
faq.answer: Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT) is located in Pune, Maharashtra, with the pincode 411025.
